findings.title: The integrated Edge click source is rejected before page binding
findings.observation: targetForClick validates the caller v23 and then substitutes exact edgeProgram/priorEdgeSource v22. prepareAndBind passes that program to ChromeClickDocumentWitness.bindScript, whose guard only accepts current sourceID v23. The call throws invalidRequest before driver.evaluate. This prevents all fresh Edge clicks that reach the document pin stage.
findings.reproduction: Compiled the exact committed pure witness source with minimal supporting value types. Chrome-current v23 returns a script; Edge-active v22 throws invalidRequest. Native driver evaluations and GUI actions were zero.
findings.requiredChange: Provide an explicitly source-scoped Edge binding route for its exact active v22 bytes while preserving the current Chrome source gate and the historical observe-only boundary. Exercise the actual Edge source selection through prepareAndBind, including disallowed prior/foreign sources.

findings.title: Merged recovery test contradicts ordinary single-observation behavior
findings.observation: The merged test loops over five scopes and nine source versions, then always asserts two observe commands and two original program IDs from a single reconcile. ordinaryProduct now directly normalizes one sample, so both product scopes return after one observe. Eighteen product cases have conflicting assertions.
findings.reproduction: Direct control-flow review of the committed test and reconcile branch; native XCTest was not executed locally.
findings.requiredChange: Assert one read per ordinaryProduct reconcile, then explicitly request a second independent read of the same original operation. Preserve original reader, receipt profile, immutable registration/journal/PNG assertions. Do not change ordinary product behavior to satisfy an obsolete polling expectation.
findings.workingTreeFollowup: The integrator supplied a matching test-only patch during review. That uncommitted patch does not change this reviewed commit or this result.

resolvedFindings.summary: Edge canonical v22 was rejected by the v23-only witness before native evaluation. The explicit browser host now accepts only its active input version. Exact-source Swift counterexample and actual generated-script VM verification pass. Historical/foreign programs remain refused.

Historical ordinary recovery test expected two observations from one single-sample reconcile. It now asserts one first observation, invokes a second independent reconcile, and still asserts two original-version reads plus both UNKNOWN/profile results and unchanged durable data. Production reconcile behavior is unchanged.
